description: Required notice for sites with affiliate links. Three variants: 'subtle' (light info background, slips into review flow), 'highlighted' (stronger border, top of page), 'band' (full-width strip with base-200 bg). Place at top of every page with affiliate CTAs to satisfy FTC / equivalent regulations.

text.default: This site contains affiliate links. We may earn a commission on purchases at no extra cost to you.
text.hint: Disclosure language. Comply with local regulator wording (FTC, ASA, etc.).

link.hint: Optional link to full disclosure page.
